production_equality.comparison: Both exact UTF-8 contents and GitHub-returned Git blob IDs match.

schema.derivation_without_help: correct and wrong remain historical counts; correctStreak is zero when old currentMisses > 0, otherwise min(currentStreak, correct); wrongStreak is zero when old currentStreak > 0, otherwise min(currentMisses, wrong). Accepted old streaks are already bounded to 1000, exactly matching Dart fromLegacy clamps.
schema.derivation_with_help: hintCount > 0 yields zero assessed counts/streaks because independent answers cannot be recovered from mixed practice. All ten historical practice fields are preserved.

unchanged_safeguards: Migration is opt-in and only exact integer tuples (2017, 2018) and (2017, 2019) are accepted. Other versions and non-integer lookalikes remain rejected.
The persisted primary owner must be the identical local-[a-f0-9]{32} value, with the same entire set of skill namespaces before and after.
Only that existing primary skill namespace may receive the additive conversion. Foreign child skill records remain byte exact and cannot be added, deleted or reassigned.
The old skill map must be nonempty and retain the identical skill membership. Map keys must equal each record skillId.
Every migrated record has exactly the ten old fields plus independentEvidence. Every old field retains its value and Python type.
The five new evidence values are exact integers matching the existing Dart derivation. Unexpected fields, duplicate JSON keys, NaN, malformed schemas and out-of-range old counters remain rejected.
The existing protected learning prefixes remain unchanged, including progress, writing progress, journal, reading sessions/story library, attempt log, wallet, school, learning and legacy data.
The same five active-profile identity fields id/name/age/grade/createdAt are compared; lastActiveAt is intentionally not historical learning data.
At least one actually earned correct answer plus positive earned stars and XP remain required. UID and firstInstallTime are preserved by the separate in-place installation gate.
After the initial update, each Kart/restart/fold snapshot must be byte exact relative to the actual after-update snapshot and still pass the transitive baseline history check.
The helper constructs a local comparison dictionary only after all schema checks; it never rewrites original Android preference evidence.
protection_scope_note: This review preserves the existing gate scope; it does not claim every preference key is byte exact. In the historical fixture, daily_mission also differs and is outside the established protected-prefix set. No additional exemption is introduced by the 2019 pairing.

metadata.scope: Exact read-only preferences of the fictional LumoTest child from a real 2017 APK lesson and real install -r 2018 offline launch. This failed gate stopped before Kart.
metadata.snapshot_encoding: Exact node.text mapping used by creative_android_probe.prefs; non-text XML values remain null and are outside the learning comparison.

reviewed_patch.state_at_review: Local Agent C patch; no new commit invented or asserted by this reviewer. Parent/root will bind the final commit.
reviewed_patch.changes: Two version-pair guards additionally accept only (2017, 2019); migration report uses its already validated actual from/to tuple. Existing fourteen migration test cases also run for 2019, plus two real-wrapper boundary tests. No preservation assertion is removed.

test_execution.scope: Synthetic validator regressions and blocked Android-I/O boundary. No new device pass is inferred.

conclusion: No semantic contradiction found. Exact 2017 to 2019 may use the unchanged narrowly validated additive migration, because the actual production serializer and independent-evidence implementation match 2018 byte for byte. A fresh actual 2017 install -> earned learning -> install -r 2019 -> offline/restart/fold proof is still mandatory.
